method: For each symbol and trade date, find contracts whose previous valid daily option bar closed above its open. Select at most one contract per symbol/day by highest previous-day volume, then highest previous-day open interest. Enter at the selected contract's current-day open and exit at its close. No commissions, taxes, slippage, bid/ask spread, lot sizing, or fill constraints are modeled. This is a daily option-price momentum proxy, not a test of AQTE, MorningEdge, QuantEdge Pro, ExpiryEdge, or Algo Desk rules.
warning: Gross daily-bar proxy only. Results are not evidence of live profitability and do not test the app's intraday strategy rules. Daily OHLC cannot determine intraday signal order or actual fills.

assumptions.selection: highest previous-day option volume, then open interest
assumptions.capital_model: compounded return assumes full account allocation on each successive trade; illustrative and not a sizing recommendation
assumptions.expiry_roll: not modeled; contracts are grouped by expiry and strike
